description:
Side-by-side sourced facts for 2-4 slugs, mixing AI build tools, agent harnesses and Agent Toolbox entries. Answers "X vs Y" questions such as Cursor vs Claude Code.
Use when: the user is choosing between specific named tools.
Do not use for: open-ended "what should I use to build X" (recommend_stack); a single tool (get_tool).
Returns: per slug: pricing with checked date and source, free tier, lowest stated $/mo, apps on Vibe Shipped, licence, interface, GitHub stars with date, MCP/subagents/headless/sandboxing (null = not stated).
Limits: 2-4 slugs; isError bad_input if fewer than 2 resolve.
Example: {"tools":["claude-code","openai-codex-cli","aider"]}

tools.description: 2-4 slugs from list_tools, list_harnesses or list_agent_tools.

name: compare_tools
title: Compare AI build tools and harnesses
